observations.body: A valley of bones receives prophetic speech, sinews, flesh, breath, and life, and the vision is interpreted as Israel saying hope is lost.

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 37:1–14 as exile, memory, and return evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The image describes national restoration through death and life language without reducing later resurrection claims to this scene alone.
